map.危险分层（JNC-7）：按分级叠加年龄、吸烟、血脂、糖尿病、靶器官损害与合并临床: Risk stratification: Layer age, smoking, lipids, diabetes, target-organ damage and comorbid diseases to classify low/medium/high/very-high risk, guiding treatment intensity.
map.目标值个体化：一般 <140/90；糖尿病/肾病/心衰多 <130/80（依指南: Individualized targets: Generally <140/90; diabetes / CKD / heart failure often <130/80 (per guidelines and tolerance), with appropriate relaxation in the elderly.
map.输入：收缩压 152 mmHg、舒张压 94 mmHg、女、62 岁、糖尿病、无: Inputs: SBP 152 mmHg, DBP 94 mmHg, female, 62 y, diabetes, non-smoker. Output: Grade 1 hypertension (DBP 94 is 90-99), Risk Very high (grade 1 with diabetes), Advice Start medication + lifestyle, Target <130/80 and stable, Monitor Home self-measurement + complication screening. Note: Diagnosis relies on standardized measurement.
map.高血压前期需要吃药吗？: Do I need medication for prehypertension?
map.多不需立即用药，优先生活方式干预（减盐、减重、运动、限酒、减压）并随访；若合并糖: Usually no immediate drugs - prioritize lifestyle intervention (less salt, weight loss, exercise, alcohol limits, stress reduction) with follow-up; if diabetes or high cardiovascular risk coexists, physicians may start medication earlier to prevent target-organ damage.
map.诊室一次测量易受体位、情绪与白大衣效应影响；家庭或 24h 动态可反映日常真实血: A single office reading is easily affected by posture, emotion and the white-coat effect; home or 24h ambulatory monitoring reflects true daily blood pressure, identifies masked hypertension, and helps judge goal attainment and adjust therapy.
map.长期不控制会怎样？: What if hypertension is left uncontrolled long term?
map.持续高压损害心、脑、肾、眼底与血管，增加卒中、心梗、心衰、肾衰与痴呆风险；早诊早: Sustained high pressure damages the heart, brain, kidney, retina and vessels, raising risks of stroke, MI, heart failure, renal failure and dementia; early diagnosis, control and sustained goal attainment are key to reducing complications.
map.关于「高血压(JNC分级)风险分层器」: About the Hypertension (JNC) Risk Stratification Tool
map.基于JNC-7标准的高血压分级与心血管风险分层器，根据收缩压、舒张压及危险因素、: A hypertension grading and cardiovascular risk stratification tool based on JNC-7, integrating systolic/diastolic BP with risk factors, target-organ damage and concomitant clinical conditions.
map.依据国际/中国心血管指南与公开公式标准（ESC/ACC/AHA 等）逐项计算: Calculated item by item per international / Chinese cardiovascular guidelines and published formula standards (ESC/ACC/AHA, etc.)
map.实时输出风险分层、关键截断值与分级: Real-time output of risk stratification, key cutoff values and staging
map.输入数值可复核，过程透明可追溯: Input values are verifiable; the process is transparent and traceable
map.数据本地处理，不上传服务器: Data is processed locally and not uploaded to any server
map.血压分级取收缩压(SBP)与舒张压(DBP)较高级别：正常 <120/80、高血: BP category uses the higher of SBP and DBP: normal <120/80, prehypertension <140/90, stage 1 <160/100, stage 2 >=160 or >=100 mmHg. JNC-7 risk stratification: low risk (normal/prehypertension without risk factors); moderate risk (normal/prehypertension with 1-2 risk factors, or stage 1/2 without risk factors); high risk (normal/prehypertension with a clinical condition, or stage 1 with 1-2 risk factors); very high risk (stage 1 with target-organ damage/clinical condition, or stage 2 with any risk factor or target-organ damage).

BP grade uses the higher of systolic (SBP) and diastolic (DBP): normal <120/80, prehypertension 120–139/80–89, grade 1 140–159/90–99, grade 2 ≥160 or ≥100 mmHg. Risk stratification follows JNC-7 (2003): normal/prehypertension with <3 risk factors and no TOD/clinical condition → average risk; ≥3 or TOD/ACC → high; grade 1 with no risk factors → low, 1–2 → moderate, ≥3 or TOD/ACC → high; grade 2 with no risk factors → moderate, 1–2 → high, ≥3 or TOD/ACC → very high.
map.JNC-7 已被 2017 ACC/AHA 与《中国高血压防治指南（2024 年: JNC-7 has been superseded by the 2017 ACC/AHA guideline and the 2024 Chinese hypertension guideline; this page is a historical JNC-7 teaching/reference only. Use current guidelines for clinical stratification.
map.正常/前期 + <3 个危险因素，且无靶器官损害/临床情况: Normal/prehypertension + <3 risk factors and no TOD/clinical condition
map.1级 + 1–2 个危险因素；或 2级 + 无危险因素: Grade 1 + 1–2 risk factors; or grade 2 + no risk factors
map.正常/前期 + ≥3 个危险因素或靶器官损害/临床情况；1级 + ≥3 个或靶器: Normal/prehypertension + ≥3 risk factors or TOD/clinical condition; grade 1 + ≥3 or TOD/clinical condition; grade 2 + 1–2 risk factors
map.2级 + ≥3 个危险因素或靶器官损害/临床情况: Grade 2 + ≥3 risk factors or TOD/clinical condition
map.糖尿病在 JNC-7 原文中列为「危险因素」（本页已归入危险因素计数）；临床实践: Diabetes is listed as a risk factor in JNC-7 (counted as a risk factor here); in practice diabetes is often managed as high risk, while this page follows the JNC-7 table item by item.
map.提示：JNC-7（2003）已被 2017 ACC/AHA 与《中国高血压防治指: Note: JNC-7 (2003) has been superseded by 2017 ACC/AHA and the 2024 Chinese hypertension guideline; this page is historical teaching/reference only. When SBP and DBP fall in different grades, use the higher grade. Risk strata are for clinical reference; treatment decisions require a physician using current guidelines.
map.以生活方式干预为主，3–6 个月复查评估血压；合并 1–2 个危险因素时需更积极: Lifestyle intervention first, reassess BP in 3–6 months; with 1–2 risk factors, control should be more proactive.
map.合并靶器官损害/临床情况或≥3 个危险因素，建议启动药物治疗并强化危险因素管理，: With TOD/clinical condition or ≥3 risk factors, start drug therapy and intensify risk-factor management, target <130/80 mmHg, regular follow-up.
map.立即启动药物治疗，严格控制血压<130/80mmHg，并处理靶器官损害/伴随疾病: Start drug therapy immediately, strictly control BP <130/80 mmHg, manage TOD/comorbidities, regular follow-up.
map.生活方式干预1–3个月，未达标则启动药物治疗，目标<140/90mmHg。: Lifestyle intervention for 1–3 months; start drug therapy if not at target, target <140/90 mmHg.
map.生活方式干预1–3个月，血压不达标再启动药物治疗，目标<140/90mmHg。: Lifestyle intervention for 1–3 months; start drug therapy if BP is not at target, target <140/90 mmHg.
map.立即启动药物治疗，严格控制血压<130/80mmHg，积极治疗伴随疾病与靶器官损: Start drug therapy immediately, strictly control BP <130/80 mmHg, actively treat comorbidities and TOD, regular follow-up.
map.生活方式干预+药物治疗，目标血压<130/80mmHg，定期评估靶器官损害。: Lifestyle intervention plus drug therapy, target <130/80 mmHg, periodically assess TOD.
map.生活方式干预并启动药物治疗，目标<140/90mmHg，1–3个月复评。: Lifestyle intervention and start drug therapy, target <140/90 mmHg, reassess in 1–3 months.
map.危险分层（JNC-7）：按分级叠加年龄、吸烟、血脂、糖尿病、靶器官损害与合并临床: Risk stratification (JNC-7): combine grade with age, smoking, lipids, diabetes, TOD and clinical disease into average/low/moderate/high/very high risk to determine treatment intensity.
map.输入：收缩压 152 mmHg、舒张压 94 mmHg、女、62 岁、糖尿病、无: Input: SBP 152 mmHg, DBP 94 mmHg, female, 62 years, diabetes, non-smoker. Output: grade 1 hypertension; moderate risk (grade 1 + 1 risk factor per the JNC-7 table; diabetes is often managed as high risk in practice); lifestyle intervention + consider starting drugs; target <140/90 (often <130/80 with diabetes); home monitoring + complication screening. Note: diagnosis requires standardized measurement; JNC-7 has been superseded.
